Here's a summary of the plugin system refactoring:

### New files
- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface with lifecycle hooks (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile`, `onEnd`), `Page` and `BuildOptions` types, plus `loadPluginsFromConfig()` to load user plugins
- **`src/plugins/markdown.ts`** — `MarkdownPlugin` encapsulating `parseMarkdownFile` and `readContentDirectory`
- **`src/plugins/template.ts`** — `TemplatePlugin` encapsulating `renderPage`, `renderIndex` (hardcoded fallback), and Handlebars template rendering
- **`src/plugins/devserver.ts`** — `DevServerPlugin` plus all server logic (`createServer`, `startServer`, `injectLiveReload`, live reload)
- **`ssg.config.ts`** — Config file for loading user plugins from `./plugins/`
- **`plugins/`** — Directory for user plugin TypeScript modules

### Modified files
- **`src/generator.ts`** — Core engine now orchestrates the plugin pipeline: loads built-in plugins + config plugins, then runs each lifecycle hook in order on all plugins
- **`src/server.ts`** — Re-exports from `DevServerPlugin` for backward compatibility

### Key design decisions
- Plugin hooks are synchronous to maintain the existing `generateSite` signature
- Pipeline runs all plugins' hooks in order at each lifecycle stage
- Markdown/rendering logic extracted into plugins while core engine handles I/O
- User plugins loaded from `ssg.config.ts` via `loadPluginsFromConfig()`
